main.description: LangGraph failure replanner. Takes a structured COLMAP failure (errorCode + errorMessage from `colmapTile`) and decides: retry-with-relaxed-thresholds | request-more-images | downgrade-to-osm-extrude | mark-unrecoverable. State is checkpointed to `vertex_langgraph_state` so a Pod restart resumes the same decision. The BPMN exclusive gateway routes accordingly; today the loop short-circuits to End on first failure (single-pass) — multi-pass replanning is deferred until the steady-state success rate is measured.

retryHints.description: Optional knobs the next colmapTile attempt should use.
